What owners ask first.

I am not ready to sell. Should we still talk?

Yes. Most owners we speak with are not selling today. A conversation now means you know your options before you need them.

Who will operate my community?

An experienced operator, lined up before closing and matched to your community’s culture and needs. Boldt does not operate senior living communities.

What happens to my residents and employees?

Planning for your residents and team starts before closing, so disruption stays low and the people you care about are looked after.

Can I keep a share and defer taxes?

Yes, you can keep a share of the real estate and benefit if its value grows. Taxes on the share you keep may be deferred. Your CPA should run the numbers for your situation.

Wouldn’t a broker get me more money?

A broker may get a higher offer. What owners value in a direct sale is certainty, confidentiality and a structure built around taxes and future value. The highest offer is not always the most money kept after taxes.

What if my children might take over?

Many owners are still weighing that. It helps to ask whether your children want to run the community day to day, or would rather own real estate without operating it.

Is there a path to a complete sale?

Yes. Some owners sell outright. Others keep a share. The structure is built around your goals.

What does a first conversation cost?

Nothing, and there is no commitment. You will come away knowing what your community is worth and which paths are open to you.
